definition: A long-range, low-power radio technique. It trades speed for distance, so a tiny radio can send short messages for miles.
explanation: LoRa (short for "Long Range") is the radio layer underneath Meshtastic. It spreads each transmission across a wide slice of spectrum, which lets a receiver pick out a signal that is weaker than the background noise. The cost is speed: LoRa carries a few hundred bytes at a time, which is why Meshtastic handles text and positions but not voice or pictures.
